title: asperula baldaccii
intro: Asperula baldaccii, commonly known as Woodruff, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety, and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Asperula baldaccii are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, ease pain, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
